# Vendored: w3c/vc-di-ecdsa-test-suite

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/w3c/vc-di-ecdsa-test-suite
- **Commit:** `94dca21d8c1c7ad3dc31f21144d4d957567726b5` (2026-08-27T11:45:05-04:00)
- **Retrieved:** 2026-10-28, `git clone --depth 1`
- **Licence:** BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE.md`, Copyright (c) 2023-2024, World Wide Web Consortium)

Vendored in the same way as `../vc-di-eddsa/`, so that the official W3C Data
Integrity `ecdsa-rdfc-2019` and `ecdsa-jcs-2019` interoperability suite can run
offline against `bin/vc-api-shim/server.mjs`. `.git` metadata was stripped
after clone (a plain vendored copy, not a submodule).

## What is committed and what is not

- Suite source (`tests/`, `config/`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json`,
  `w3c.json`, `localConfig.example.cjs`, `LICENSE.md`, `LICENSES/`) is
  committed as cloned. `reports/` held only `.gitkeep` upstream (no generated
  HTML), so nothing was dropped.
- `node_modules/` is NOT committed (gitignored). Install with:

  ```sh
  cd third_party/testing/vc-di-ecdsa
  npm install
  ```

  The `postinstall` script clones `w3c/vc-di-ecdsa` (spec test vectors) into
  `tests/input/vc-di-ecdsa/` (gitignored). `npm install` pulls
  `data-integrity-test-suite-assertion` and `vc-test-suite-implementations`
  from GitHub, so it needs network access once.
- `localConfig.cjs` is generated by `tests/vc-di-ecdsa/run.sh` (gitignored). It
  points the issuer and verifier tags at the shim.

## Scope run

Runner: `tests/vc-di-ecdsa/run.sh`. Tags `ecdsa-rdfc-2019` and
`ecdsa-jcs-2019`, key type P-256 only. Files run: `05-rdfc-di-create`,
`15-rdfc-di-verify`, `70-data-model`, `90-algorithms-rdfc`,
`90-algorithms-jcs`. Not run: `ecdsa-sd-2023` files, P-384, and the interop
files (`enableInteropTests` stays at its default, false).
